introduction: Improve your English vocabulary and listening in just six minutes! Filming sex scenes or passionate

vocabulary.definition: a close romantic or sexual relationship
vocabulary.example: Their on-screen intimacy was so convincing that they won awards for their performances.

vocabulary.definition: a very popular and successful movie or book that sells many copies
vocabulary.example: The new superhero movie is expected to be a blockbuster at the box office.

vocabulary.definition: to do or make something that looks real but is not
vocabulary.example: The actors had to simulate a car crash for the action scene in the movie.

vocabulary.definition: a legal document to either allow or prevent something being done in a different way from usual
vocabulary.example: Before filming the scene, all actors signed a waiver regarding the use of special effects.

vocabulary.definition: to touch gently in a pleasurable way
vocabulary.example: She stroked the cat's fur and it purred contentedly.

vocabulary.definition: emphasizing every single one of something
vocabulary.example: The chef checked each and every ingredient before starting to cook the dish.
